simplify_expression: simplify a C preprocessor conditional expression like defined(FOO) or 1 && 0 to its boolean result
sort_includes: sort a list of C include directives alphabetically with system headers before local headers
sort_copyrights: sort and deduplicate copyright notice lines by earliest year and merge overlapping entries
run_acme: run the acme single-header library generator on an input header file and compare output to expected
test_simplify_expression_forced_defines: test simplify_expression with forced defines to evaluate preprocessor conditions with predefined macro values
